title: Physics Attention Transformer Surrogate for Rapid Vertical Instability Growth Rate Prediction: Alcator C-Mod to SPARC
abstract: arXiv:2608.24785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In this work, we investigate rapid prediction of the dominant $n{=}0$ vertical instability growth rate in C-Mod and SPARC equilibria, where nonrigid free boundary response models are too slow for control cycle use. Using a Physics Attention Transformer trained on MEQ-FGE-L labels, we predict both the scalar growth rate and the associated two dimensional perturbed toroidal current density. We find mean absolute errors of 5.4~s$^{-1}$ on held out C-Mod equilibria and 12.7~s$^{-1}$ on synthetic SPARC cases, with spatial eigenfunction errors near 5\%. We also compared PAT with operator based ML models : FNO2D and DeepONet, where we found PAT predicts a much lower normalised growth rate error and improved spatial reconstruction. These results indicate that PAT can reproduce MEQ-FGE-L outputs at control relevant latency and could support future studies of growth rate headroom monitoring and proximity aware shape control.

translated_title: 物理注意力变压器代理模型用于快速垂直不稳定性增长率预测：从Alcator C-Mod到SPARC
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24785v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在这项工作中，我们研究了在C-Mod和SPARC平衡中快速预测主导的$n{=}0$垂直不稳定性增长率，其中非刚性自由边界响应模型对于控制周期使用来说太慢。使用在MEQ-FGE-L标签上训练的物理注意力变压器，我们预测了标量增长率以及相关的二维扰动环向电流密度。我们在保留的C-Mod平衡上发现平均绝对误差为5.4~s$^{-1}$，在合成SPARC案例上为12.7~s$^{-1}$，空间特征函数误差接近5%。我们还将PAT与基于算子的机器学习模型（FNO2D和DeepONet）进行了比较，发现PAT预测的归一化增长率误差更低，空间重建效果更好。这些结果表明，PAT能够在控制相关的延迟下重现MEQ-FGE-L输出，并可能支持未来增长率余量监测和邻近感知形状控制的研究。
tldr: 本文提出了一种物理注意力变压器模型，能够以控制相关延迟快速预测托卡马克等离子体的垂直不稳定性增长率，显著优于现有算子学习模型，并支持未来实时控制应用。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Physics Attention Transformer model that rapidly predicts vertical instability growth rates in tokamak plasmas at control-relevant latency, significantly outperforming existing operator learning models and supporting future real-time control applications.
